newsitem.title: USA: Medical Device acquires product line.
newsitem.headline: Medical Device acquires product line.

text.p: Medical Device Technologies Inc said early Tuesday it has acquired the Biotrack product line, including worldwide distribution rights, from privately held Boehringer Mannheim Inc for $1.35 million.

In connection with the acquisition, the company will acquire $1.15 million of inventory, an estimated $700,000 in manufacturing equipment, and the worldwide rights to the seven associated patents and trademarks.

The Biotrack product line consists of a small instrument analyzer and three types of disposable cartridges, the company said. The system is used in doctors' offices and central labs to measure patient blood drug levels for the commonly prescribed therapeutic drugs to control asthma and epilepsy.
